dogecoin.text:
Dogecoin to the moon? More like Musk's meme machine pumping bags!  
Shiba Inu barks loud, but AI coins like Render are the real brains.  
Layer 2? Snore. Web3? Yawn.  
Crypto bros, stop chasing pumps and HODL some wit!

Meme coins pumping while ETH dreams of flipping BTC?  
Keep hodling, degens - your bags are heavier than Vitalik's code.  
Little Pepe's building empires, Dogecoin's just a tired Shiba.  
Crypto's a circus, and we're all clowns. 🤡
